company.name: Auterion
company.shortDescription: Auterion provides a platform that unifies a diverse fleet of autonomous robots, catering to a wide range of applications and use cases.
company.description: Auterion is the leading autonomy software company building swarms, not drones. Its operating system, AuterionOS, transforms individual unmanned systems into coordinated swarms across air, land, and sea. Auterion technology has been battle-proven in Ukraine, powering one of the largest autonomous deployments in modern warfare, and Auterion is applying the lessons learned there globally, including helping Taiwan develop its swarming capabilities Headquartered in Arlington, VA and with offices in Munich, Germany and hubs across Europe, Auterion partners with the US and its allies, major defense primes, and startups, to deliver autonomous mass with AI-enabled swarms that resist jamming, overwhelm defenses, and secure mission success. By uniting global manufacturers under one interoperable platform, Auterion is defining the next era of warfare: software-first, scalable, and built to defend the freedoms we enjoy.
